text: Fix the firstmate study's 'Reopened' state. The source check after each landing has refused the study page three times today on the same claim: firstmate-work-handling/page-text/model.json marks 'reopened' as a terminal-success state that ends the task, and intro.json says 'Done and Reopened both carry the tag "ends the task"'. The code does not end the item; it sends the backlog row back to Queued (bin/fm-teardown.sh around lines 3894-3896). Correct the model and the intro text so the source check passes. Acceptance: the source check passes on the study page for the reopened state.
